raw.description: Purchase a new phone number. This is a paid purchase that charges the account's balance. area_code requests a specific region (e.g. '415' for San Francisco); agent_id attaches it on purchase. Requires confirm=true to proceed.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to attach this number to immediately

area_code.description: 3-digit area code for a specific region (e.g. '415', '212', '310')

confirm.description: Must be true to complete the purchase. When false, no number is bought.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, CA, GB)

raw.description:
Create a new agent. An agent owns phone numbers and handles calls/SMS.

A newly created agent has no phone number until one is attached.
Set voice_mode to 'hosted' with a system_prompt for autonomous AI voice calls, or 'webhook' (default) to forward call transcripts to your webhook URL.

ambient_sound.description: Optional background ambience for call audio. Not a substitute for the AI self-identification, which is always disclosed.

begin_message.description: What the AI says when a call connects. Only used in 'hosted' mode.

denoising_mode.description: Audio denoising. The aggressive mode helps callers in cars/cafes (small surcharge).

description.description: Description of what this agent does

enable_backchannel.description: Whether the agent interjects 'uh-huh'/'mhmm' while the caller speaks. Default true.

enable_messaging.description: Whether a hosted agent can send and read texts during a call. Default true.

interruption_sensitivity.description: How easily callers can interrupt (barge in). 0 = never, 1 = at first sound. Default 0.8.

language.description: BCP-47 locale for speech recognition and synthesis, e.g. 'en-US', 'es-ES', 'ja-JP'.

max_silence_ms.description: Hang up after this many ms of caller silence. Default 600000 (10 min).

model_tier.description: Model quality/speed tier for hosted-mode agents. 'turbo' = fastest/cheapest, 'balanced' (default) = general use, 'max' = highest quality.

name.description: Name for the agent (e.g. 'Customer Support', 'Sales Bot')

stt_mode.description: Speech-to-text mode: 'fast' (default) lowest latency, 'accurate' for exact names/numbers (~200ms slower).

system_prompt.description: Required when voice_mode is 'hosted'. The AI's personality and instructions for voice calls.

transfer_number.description: Phone number to transfer calls to (E.164 format). Enables call transfer during conversations.

voice.description: Voice ID for the agent. Defaults to 'Skylar - Friendly Guide'.

voice_mode.description: 'webhook' (default) forwards transcripts to your webhook. 'hosted' uses built-in AI with system_prompt.

voice_speed.description: Speech speed multiplier. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double.

voicemail_message.description: Voicemail greeting text. When set, unanswered calls hear this message and can leave a voicemail.

raw.description:
Initiate an outbound, webhook-driven phone call where your backend handles the conversation logic.

The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured. The call always opens by identifying itself as an AI assistant (added automatically).

agent_id.description: The agent ID (the agent must have a phone number attached)

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to call from (if agent has multiple numbers)

initial_greeting.description: What the agent says when the call connects

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

voice.description: Voice ID override for this call

raw.name: make_call

raw.description:
Place a phone call where the AI has an autonomous conversation about a given topic — scheduling, surveys, follow-ups, etc. No webhook setup needed.

The agent must have a phone number attached.
Every call opens by identifying itself as an AI assistant (added automatically and cannot be disabled via topic or initial_greeting).
By default this blocks until the call finishes and returns the full transcript. Set wait=false for fire-and-forget.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (must have a phone number attached)

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to call from (if agent has multiple numbers)

initial_greeting.description: What the AI says when the call connects. If not set, the AI will generate one from the topic.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the call to complete. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

topic.description: The conversation goal for the AI to pursue. Embedded as the call objective inside a locked system prompt that always enforces AI self-identification (identity rules can't be overridden). Be specific about what to discuss and any goals.

voice.description: Voice ID override for this call

wait.description: When true (default), blocks until the call ends and returns the full transcript.

raw.description:
Create, update, or delete a saved contact. Set `action` to choose the operation.

- create: requires phone_number and name
- update: requires contact_id; only the fields you pass are changed
- delete: requires contact_id (permanent)

contact_id refers to a saved contact.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234). Required for 'create'.

raw.name: manage_contact

raw.description:
Send an SMS or iMessage from one of your agent's phone numbers, or react to a message.

The agent must have at least one phone number attached. If the agent has multiple numbers, number_id or from_number selects which one to send from.
iMessage extras (silently ignored on SMS): reply_to_message_id threads the reply under an earlier message, and send_style adds an expressive screen/bubble effect.
To react to a message instead of sending one, set reaction and react_to_message_id (iMessage only); to_number and body are not needed in that case.

agent_id.description: The agent ID to send from (the agent must have a phone number attached). Optional if you pass from_number or number_id instead.

body.description: The message text to send (may be empty when sending media only)

from_number.description: Exact number to send from in E.164 format (alternative to number_id)

media_url.description: URL of a single image/media file to attach

media_urls.description: Multiple media URLs to attach (delivered as an image carousel on iMessage)

number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to send from (if agent has multiple numbers)

react_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of a message to react to. Set together with `reaction`.

reaction.description: iMessage only. Tapback or single emoji applied to react_to_message_id: one of love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, question, or a single emoji (e.g. '🔥'). When set, this reacts instead of sending a message.

reply_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of an earlier message to reply to inline (threaded reply)

send_style.description: iMessage only. Expressive screen/bubble effect to send with the message

to_number.description: Recipient: a phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234), a US short code, or a group ID (grp_...) to post into an iMessage group chat. Required when sending a message (not needed for a reaction).

raw.name: send_message

raw.description:
Set a webhook URL to receive inbound messages and call events.

Pass agent_id to set a webhook for a specific agent (overrides project default). Omit agent_id to set the project-level webhook for all agents.
The webhook secret is returned — use it to verify signatures.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to set webhook for that agent only. Omit for project-level.

context_limit.description: Number of recent messages to include as conversation context (0-50)

url.description: The publicly accessible webhook URL (must be HTTPS in production)

raw.name: set_webhook

raw.description:
